Advanced Photoshop course overview

There is no doubt in fact that Adobe Photoshop is hands down, one of the splendid invention by Adobe. Used by professionals graphic designers across the globe. It has become a ‘go-to-tool’ for millions of designers, photographers, and UI design professionals. 

This advanced Photoshop course will make you expert in using Photoshop with guarantee. You can apply your knowledge of Photoshop in all the design industry including, graphic, photography, web, animation, architecture, interior, and fashion designing etc.

Why our Photoshop classes in Delhi are best?

  • Photoshop classes from real design experts
  • Covers print and electronic design media
  • Opportunity for live projects after Advanced Photoshop course

Get the curriculum of the course.

Get all information through the brochure.

Request Brochure

 

Software Adobe Photoshop
    Key Takeaways
  • Fundamentals of Photoshop
  • Sizes & Measurements
  • Basics of Visual Grammar
  • Image Editing Techniques
  • Photo Montage and Manipulation
  • Color Balancing and Filters
  • Special Text Effects
  • Digital and Matte Painting
  • Collage and Masking
  • GIFs and Animation
  • Designing for Print & Web
  • Mobiles UI Designing
  • Architecture Industry Designing
  • iOS and Android Design Guidelines
  • Graphics for TV and News Channels
  • Resume and Portfolio Development

ADMEC Multimedia Institute is conducting training in advanced Photoshop course which is a multimedia designing course. Therefore, it is a complete and most advanced course of Photoshop in Rohini, Delhi. You will learn Photoshop from basics to advanced level for all the media including print, websites, mobile apps, architecture, interior, and broad casting. This course covers design thinking and idea development exercises too.

Our institute in Delhi has planned this advanced Photoshop course which is ideal for individuals who are eager to explore Photoshop tools at:

  • Highly advanced level
  • Gain an understanding of photo editing
  • Color enhancements and gradings
  • Drawing and Sketching
  • Visual Grammar
  • Creation of user interfaces for websites & print media
  • Removing backgrounds
  • Merging images
  • Architectural plan rendering
  • Making of texture & patterns and much more.

Prerequisites for advanced Photoshop course

This advanced Photoshop course will allow you to develop designing and thinking skills for all the popular media. Learn what are some requirements to join this advanced Photoshop course.

Familiarity with Mac/ Windows Operating System

Flair for design and innovate new concepts

Keen on learning new technology

Who can join this advanced Photoshop course

Anyone – a designer or non-designer. Photoshop classes are a multi-purpose option for each type of designer.

Course structure of Photoshop classes in Delhi

The Photoshop course is well organized to deliver the best and quality training. This will help students in learning in-depth concepts efficiently.

This advanced Photoshop course needs a higher level creative mind set to plan and draft the new and innovative ideas for your clients in future. Our Photoshop classes in Delhi offer training on visual grammar, drawing, and sketching so that you can scribble your imagination on papers then on computers.

We will cover topics in the most comprehensive manner.

What you will learn in these Photoshop classes?

Once you complete this advanced Photoshop course, you will be perfect in these things:

• Logo Making
• Image Editing
• Photo Album Designing
• Poster, Covers, and Packaging Designs
• Textures, Patterns, and Background Designing
• Text and 3D Effects
• Digital and Matte Painting
• UI Designing for Websites and Apps
• Architecture Design Projects
• Broadcasting Design
• Portfolio Development etc.

Career options after Photoshop classes

Our advanced Photoshop course will make you a versatile designer. You can create designs for various design disciplines.

• Photo Editor
• Photoshop Expert
• UI Designer
• Image Editor
• Creative Art Designer
• Plan Renderer
• Digital Painting Artist
• Matte Painting Artist
• Broadcasting Designer etc.
